title: OC-OPD: Observation-coordinated Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.01965v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reverse and forward Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergences provide complementary supervision in on-policy distillation: reverse KL refines the student's active token rankings, and forward KL allocates mass to teacher-supported candidates. At student-generated prefixes, we form a four-observation matrix by treating the student and teacher as both candidate sources and evaluators. The diagonal self-observations measure uncertainty, while source-centered cross-observations recover the two KL objectives. We establish an exact identity equating the Fisher inverse-metric coupling of their logit gradients with the sum of these contrasts, yielding a common local descent direction for distinct positive distributions. Observation-coordinated on-policy distillation (OC-OPD) uses observations to set preferences, closed-form bargaining to coordinate gradients, and distributional discrepancy to scale the update. translated_title: OC-OPD：面向在线策略蒸馏的观测协同监督
translated_abstract: 在在线策略蒸馏中，反向 KL 散度与前向 KL 散度提供互补的监督信号：反向 KL 细化学生模型主动的 token 排序，前向 KL 则将概率质量分配给教师模型支持的候选。在学生生成的前缀处，我们将学生与教师同时视为候选来源和评估者，构建一个四观测矩阵。对角线上的自观测用于衡量不确定性，而以来源为中心的交叉观测则恢复出两个 KL 目标。我们建立了一个精确恒等式，将两者 logit 梯度的 Fisher 逆度量耦合等同于这些对比项之和，从而为不同的正分布产生共同的局部下降方向。观测协同在线策略蒸馏（OC-OPD）利用观测来设定偏好，通过闭式谈判来协调梯度，并利用分布差异来缩放更新。在三个异构学生模型上……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 OC-OPD 方法，通过将学生与教师同时视为候选来源和评估者构建四观测矩阵，统一了在线策略蒸馏中反向与前向 KL 散度的互补监督，实现协调一致的梯度更新。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes OC-OPD, which unifies the complementary supervision of reverse and forward KL divergences in on-policy distillation by forming a four-observation matrix treating the student and teacher as both candidate sources and evaluators, coordinating gradients through closed-form bargaining.
